ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:2 ratio of high-intensity (light gray/white) to low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels across the visible ventral area, with the left lobe exhibiting higher concentrations of light pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, elongated high-intensity region occupying the distal and medial portions of the left lobe; the right lobe contains sparse, diffuse high-intensity clusters primarily concentrated near the trailing edge and midline.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 145 degrees and a shallow pixel-depth relative to total fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-4 pixels in height) along the trailing edge of both lobes, appearing more irregular on the right lobe distal boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge leading to tapered, slightly upturned distal tips.
